title: Untested guard path: config/read stdin write failure must release the pending thread-setup slot
outcome:
Claude review session-6531, Low at src/codex.rs:1242, and the parent raises it
because of what the surrounding code says about itself.

The change adds a THIRD `?` inside the window guarded by
PendingCodexThreadSetupGuard - a config/read stdin write failure propagating out
of start_shared_codex_engram_config_read via start_codex_json_rpc_request_with_id
- and NO TEST EXERCISES IT.

WHY THIS ONE MATTERS MORE THAN ITS SEVERITY SUGGESTS: the guard's own doc
comment at src/codex.rs:2122-2139 records that the LAST UNTESTED GUARD PATH WAS
A LIVE DEFECT, and that "deleting it left the suite green". The file documents
its own history of exactly this regression.

COVERAGE THAT EXISTS AND WHY IT IS NOT ENOUGH: the coordinator required a
config/read failure case that does not lose the parked prompt, and the package
delivers engram_bootstrap_config_failure_is_visible_and_allows_retry covering
RPC error, timeout, missing config and wrong type. The requirement was met in
substance. THE HOLE IS NARROWER: the stdin WRITE failure on the config/read
itself. engram_bootstrap_thread_start_write_failure_releases_resolved_setup
covers only the later thread/start write.

FAILURE SCENARIO: a regression that skipped the release here would wedge the
session in {setup in flight} and park every later prompt forever - with a green
suite.

FIX DIRECTION: add a BrokenWriter case on the FIRST prompt asserting the slot is
released and the transport error reaches the writer loop.
disposal_reason: Backlog triage w-930e4d333f07 (Architect1 batch 3a, spot-checked by Termal::Fable2): CLOSE-DONE. The test exists: src/tests/shared_codex.rs:4538 on master.
